reasons: Use fit-for-purpose data rather than requiring academic-grade completeness.
WorldPop R2024B unconstrained population grid is a practical candidate-inhabited-cell locator, with its beta/modelled-surface limitation disclosed.
ScienceDB V8 monthly sunshine percentage is converted to estimated annual sunshine hours and used for first-pass screening, not as a precise site-level measurement.
A 90% population-weighted sunshine coverage threshold is sufficient for this first-pass national screen; 99% is unnecessarily demanding.
The previous run's altitude exception decision order incorrectly marked low-altitude inhabited samples as incomplete when additional candidate points were intentionally not queried.

corrected_rules.sunshine_hard_exclusion: population-weighted valid sunshine coverage >=90%; estimated annual sunshine maximum across valid positive-population cells <1725 hours, with 75-hour guard band
corrected_rules.altitude_exception: any observed inhabited sample <=2000m retains the unit
corrected_rules.altitude_strong_fail: all 10 samples >2000m with unsampled inhabited cells remains pending

population_methodology_caveat: WorldPop R2024B unconstrained is not a direct upgrade to R2025A constrained; the two are different releases/models and their population totals are not directly comparable.
WorldPop unconstrained can allocate nonzero population to all land cells, including areas that may not be residential.
The active run is retained as a rural-omission sensitivity test, not as the final residential-cell mask.
formal_primary_method: WorldPop R2025A constrained settlement cells, supplemented by independently supported rural-settlement exceptions
rural_exception_rule: An unconstrained-only cell is not accepted as residential solely because its population estimate is positive; it needs independent settlement/building evidence or a strong population threshold and spatial context. Otherwise mark the county/local area pending.

data_quality_policy.rationale: A 90% population-weighted valid-data coverage is adequate for this national first-pass screen; do not require near-perfect 99% coverage. Below 90% remains pending rather than blocking the entire national run.
data_quality_policy.missing_data: Use available valid data; mark local gaps pending and continue other units.
data_quality_policy.use: LOW confidence may be used for provisional comparison but not as sole basis for hard exclusion.

previous_sensitivity_result.note: The run produced full result tables before its workflow was cancelled during the subsequent job transition; its 99% coverage rule is superseded by the current 90% fit-for-purpose rule.

methodology_note: Current operational first-pass result. WorldPop R2024B unconstrained 1km population is a modelled inhabited-cell locator, not a building register; use for broad county-level screening and preserve local exceptions for later subarea review.
